title: Parade Uniform
author: Pr1nted
$comment: The main theme. C minor, march-tempo, timpani and low brass under a sax/horn melody with a solo violin over the top -- ceremonial rather than celebratory, which is why valence sits below zero. Listed for every context because it is currently the only piece; when there are others, narrowing this to ["menu"] is what will let the mood picker do real work in-game.
